{{DISPLAYTITLE:vasp.lock}}
The {{FILE|vasp.lock}} file is only used in combination with {{TAG|ICHARG}}=5. In each SCF step before constructing the new charge density VASP checks if the {{FILE|vasp.lock}} file is present, and if not waits before continuing. The file is empty, and its content is not considered in any way by VASP.
